When not in use she literally stores it up her ass. She has freckles on her cheeks, both buttcheeks and the ones on her face.

She loves playing dangerous games like running along train tracks or messing with electical cables due to her body being invulnerable.

Large enough items like a church or other religious site will work regardless but she can enter these areas with preparation. Staying there is harmful to her health though.
